theorem: If rho_i x^2 ln(1/x)<1, then |D_i/EH|>=1-rho_i x^2 ln(1/x)>0. Hence no real root exists in any tested domain satisfying the residual gate, regardless of s_i.
SM_result: For W1=1, S_h2=4 and W_C=283, rho_0=4<2e closes the scalar interval, but rho_2=283/5>2e does not exclude a spin-2 root near the cutoff. The local arenas remain many orders inside the no-root gate.
